definitions.explanation: the melodious singing sounds made by birds

examples.english: I woke up to the sound of birdsong in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鳥|とり}のさえずり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk in the forest while listening to the birds singing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、いろいろな{鳥|とり}のさえずり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きて{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, you can hear the songs of various birds, and it feels wonderful.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧ (bird) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (possessive particle) + ⟦さえずり→さえずり：10349_saezuri⟧ (singing, chirping). ⟦さえずり→さえずり：10349_saezuri⟧ is the noun form of ⟦さえずる→さえずる：07364_saezuru⟧ (to chirp, to warble), which specifically describes the melodious singing of small birds, not the calls of larger birds like crows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥|とり}のさえずり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: birdsong can be heard
- {鳥|とり}のさえずり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目|め}が{覚|さ}める→目が覚める：23498_megasameru⟧: to wake up to birdsong
- {鳥|とり}のさえずり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける→耳を傾ける：06903_mimiwokatamukeru⟧: to listen to birdsong
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{鳥|とり}のさえずり: beautiful birdsong

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さえずり→さえずり：10349_saezuri⟧: chirping, warbling — the sound itself, without specifying the source
- ⟦{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}→鳴き声：16846_nakigoe⟧: cry, call — a broader term for any animal sound
- ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: bird's voice — a more general, less poetic expression
- ⟦さえずる→さえずる：07364_saezuru⟧: to chirp, to sing — the verb form
